The '''NCR caravaner''' is a caravan driver for the [[New California Republic]] who appears in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Golden Rule]]===
This caravan driver from the [[New California Republic]] was captured by [[Hank MacLean]] and had a [[Brain-computer interface chip|mind-control chip]] implanted in the back of his head. Using the chip, Hank manipulated the caravaner into delivering a nuclear bomb to the former NCR capital of [[Shady Sands]] using a brahmin team, intending to blow up the city. Throughout the delivery, the caravan driver kept repeating the phrase, "Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter." Once the bomb was delivered, he began bleeding out, continually repeating the phrase "Mojave," and eventually died. [[Maximus]]' father [[Joseph (TV series)|Joseph]] discovered the chip in his head and then attempted to defuse the bomb, but was unable to do so. A three-minute timer began, after which [[Fall of Shady Sands|Shady Sands was destroyed]].<ref>{{FOTV|2|2}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The caravaner's constantly repeated line, "Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter," is a memetic line from ''[[Fallout: New Vegas]]'', in which it was frequently said by [[NCR trooper (Fallout: New Vegas)|NCR trooper]]s.
